copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 接入 Slack 渠道:从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器与格式化技能、注册适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/slack@4.29.0,再构建、跑注册测试,并引导你填 Slack 凭据、解析私聊地址、重启服务。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 支持 Slack 时触发,通常在 /setup 流程中或需要为 Slack workspace 接线时使用;完成后用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 接入 Slack,用 Socket Mode。
用 webhook 方式接入 Slack,我不想开长连接。
我的 Slack 私聊收不到机器人回复,帮我查一下。
say.note: 会检查事件订阅和 token 配置。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack to NanoClaw: copies the Slack adapter and formatting skill from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/slack@4.29.0, builds and tests, then collects credentials, resolves your DM channel and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw to support Slack, typically during /setup or when wiring a Slack workspace; afterwards, wire it with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Set up the Slack channel for NanoClaw using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, then walks you through app setup.

say_en.text: Connect Slack over webhook instead of a long-lived socket.
say_en.note: Needs a public HTTPS Request URL for port 3000.

say_en.text: My Slack DMs get no replies — check the event setup.
